Government Analytics Fellowship

This fellowship focuses on enhancing government efficiency by utilizing underused data for informed decision-making. Participants receive training and expert support from the World Bank and University College London to develop a Government Analytics project. The fellowship helps participants drive systemic changes within government operations by translating data into actionable insights.

Apply Now

Delivery Mode

In Person

Location

Washington DC

Language

English

Delivery Dates

Annual

Duration

6 Months

Overview

This fellowship provides an opportunity to enhance government efficiency through data-informed decision-making by leveraging underutilized government data resources. It offers a combination of in-person training and expert support from the World Bank and University College London, focusing on developing a Government Analytics project. The fellowship lasts for 6 months, with intensive full-time training for two weeks in Washington, D.C., including the Public Administration Forum and Government Analytics course. Participants will gain insights and expertise to translate governmental data into actionable decisions, fostering systemic changes in public administration. This initiative offers a platform for government officials and professionals to collaborate and catalyze improvements in governance.
